name: Modbus Monitor
description: The `modbus_monitor` component runs automations for the requests and responses that a [Modbus](https://esphome.io/components/modbus/) hub handles. On a hub with the `server` role, that is each request the hub receives and the reply to it, sent by this hub or another device. On a hub with the `client` role, that is each request the hub sends and the reply to it.

config_entries.label: Modbus ID
config_entries.description: The Modbus hub to watch. Automatically assigned when a single hub is configured.
